title: Instruction (v1.0.0)
description: A dispatch instruction sent to a driver after the dispatcher approves a recommendation. Data determines 'executed' status by observing dwell within ±15 s. Screen US-10. See ADR-0003.

schema_version.description: Read contract version (SemVer). Turn 1 produces only 1.0.0.

inst_id.description: UUID v4 uniquely identifying this instruction.

rec_id.description: UUID v4 of the recommendation that originated this instruction.

bus_id.description: Bus this instruction was sent to.

text.description: Human-readable instruction text shown to and confirmed by the driver. Frontend displays this.

status.description: Current lifecycle status. sent → received | no_confirmation | radio → executed | not_executed. 'executed' is set by data when dwell at the target stop is within ±15 s of the instructed duration.

ts_by_status.description: Timestamps for each status transition that occurred, keyed by status value. Missing keys mean that status was never reached.
